html:
SMTO-LLM-0007 — Model endpoint is unreachable

GUID: b6772bc1-90a3-4227-a428-cb9a50123d41
Slug: llm-endpoint-unreachable
Domain: LLM · Subsystem: provider

What happened

  • SMTO knows the model server's address, but this computer has no network path to it right now. This is a network problem, not a problem with the model or its key.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Make sure the computer running SMTO is online, and connected to the VPN or work network if the model server needs one. Without that network connection there's no path to the model server.
  2. Open Settings › Setup › Model routing, open the Main card and check that Endpoint has the right address. An old or mistyped address can point to a network this computer can't reach.
  3. Select Check saved model. If it still fails, ask your network administrator to check the route to that address. Blocked routes and firewall rules can only be fixed by someone who manages the network.

What success looks like

  • Check saved model on the Main card passes and a new task gets an answer.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them, with the model server's address, to your network administrator or the person who manages SMTO. Don't turn off security checks to get past this.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The operating system reported the model endpoint's network or host as unreachable (ENETUNREACH or EHOSTUNREACH) when connecting.

What this means

  • The operating system reported an unreachable network or host. That observation concerns routing to the endpoint, not model credentials, model capacity or an inference timeout. The source of the routing failure still needs to be checked.

Why this can happen

  • A route, network interface, VPN or gateway may be unavailable. The unreachable error alone does not identify the failing network component.

How to diagnose it

  • Check the route to the configured endpoint from the requesting machine. Compare its network or VPN connection with the network on which the provider is reachable.

How to fix it

  • Verify the Endpoint address in Settings › Setup › Model routing, then check routing from the Server host (ip route, ping or traceroute, VPN state and firewall rules). Restore the route or network connection with the network administrator.
  • Verify the selected endpoint and restore the required route or network connection with the network administrator.

Relevant SMTO settings

  • Open LLM Endpoint: model-configuration / llm_base_url. Applies to: new task.
  • Start a new task after changing this setting. Active and resumed tasks retain their captured values.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • The requesting machine can reach the provider address without an unreachable-host or unreachable-network error.

What not to do

  • Do not remove retained state or weaken trust checks to make an unavailable dependency appear healthy.

Technical notes

  • Typed transport exception (or exact legacy standard reason where supported); no tool outcome is inferred from connection state.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
